title: The Hot Air Balloon Festival
seo_title: Hot Air Balloon Charcuterie Board: Bread Bowls & Shopping List
description: A hot air balloon charcuterie board for 12 to 15: five bread-bowl balloons filled with dip, with fans of salami and cheese behind them, over a patchwork countryside.
hook: Five bread-bowl hot air balloons float over a patchwork countryside of cheese and crackers.

items.name: Round bread rolls or mini boules

why: Each balloon is a small round roll, hollowed into a bread bowl and filled with dip, with a half circle of meat and cheese slices fanned behind it like the colored panels of a balloon. The shape builds itself.
Below, squares of crackers and cubes of cheddar, Swiss and pepper jack become a patchwork of fields. It's one of the easier showpieces, rated 2 of 5, and great for birthdays and baby showers.

timeline.what: Make or buy the five dips and cut the vegetables and cheese.
Fan the balloon stripes, then add the ropes and baskets, then the fields.
Fill the bread bowls with the dips.

faq.q: How do you make hot air balloons on a board?
faq.a: Hollow small round rolls into bread bowls and fill them with dip, then fan meat and cheese slices in a half circle behind each one. The book has the layout and steps.
No. It's rated 2 of 5 and takes about 75 minutes.

Cut the cheese wedges and cubes the day before. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
